title: Error Spotting & Fill in the Blanks

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘He don’t / know the / answer.’
questions.e: He સાથે doesn’t આવે: He doesn’t know the answer.

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘Each of the boys / have / a bicycle.’
questions.e: Each એકવચન છે, તેથી has: Each of the boys has a bicycle.

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘She is / more taller / than her sister.’
questions.e: taller પોતે જ comparative છે; more taller ખોટું — She is taller than her sister.

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘I have seen / him / yesterday.’
questions.e: yesterday સાથે Present Perfect ન આવે: I saw him yesterday.

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘The news / are / very good.’
questions.e: news એકવચન ગણાય: The news is very good.

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘He is senior / than / me.’
questions.e: senior, junior, superior, inferior સાથે than નહીં, to આવે: He is senior to me.

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘One of my friend / is / a mechanic.’
questions.e: One of પછી બહુવચન નામ આવે: One of my friends is a mechanic.

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘We discussed about / the problem / in detail.’
questions.e: discuss સાથે about ન આવે: We discussed the problem in detail.

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘The furniture / in this room / are new.’
questions.e: furniture અગણ્ય (Uncountable) નામ છે, એકવચન: The furniture in this room is new.

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘He has been working / here / since five years.’
questions.e: સમયગાળા માટે for: for five years. ચોક્કસ શરૂઆત માટે since: since 2020.

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘The mechanic repaired / the engine / quickly.’
Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘Neither Ravi nor his friends / was / present.’
questions.e: Neither...nor માં ક્રિયાપદ નજીકના કર્તા (friends — બહુવચન) મુજબ: were present.

questions.q: He is ____ engineer.
questions.e: engineer સ્વરથી શરૂ થાય છે: an engineer.

questions.q: I am fond ____ music.
The train left ____ time.
If I ____ rich, I would buy a car.
questions.e: કાલ્પનિક સ્થિતિ (Second conditional)માં બધા કર્તા સાથે were વપરાય.

questions.q: He prevented me ____ going there.
She is good ____ drawing.
This is the boy ____ won the prize.
The machine ____ by the operator every morning.
Hardly had he reached the station ____ the train left.
No sooner did the bell ring ____ the students left.
He insisted ____ paying the bill.
The workers ____ working since morning.
questions.e: workers (બહુવચન) + since → Present Perfect Continuous: have been working.

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘My brother / is working / in a bank since 2020.’
questions.e: ‘since’ સાથે present perfect continuous: has been working.

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘He gave me / an advice / about the exam.’
questions.e: advice અગણ્ય નામ છે — ‘a piece of advice’ કે ફક્ત ‘advice’.

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘I am / knowing him / for years.’
questions.e: know જેવા stative verbs ‘-ing’માં ન આવે: I have known him for years.

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘The police / has arrested / the thief.’
questions.e: police હંમેશા બહુવચન: The police have arrested…

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘She sings / very good / in the function.’
questions.e: ક્રિયાપદને વર્ણવવા adverb: sings very well.

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘Mathematics / are / my favourite subject.’
Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘He returned back / from Surat / yesterday.’
Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘The bus / will leave / after ten minutes.’
questions.e: ભવિષ્યમાં સમયગાળો પૂરો થાય ત્યારે ‘in’: will leave in ten minutes.

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘Both of them / are / good mechanics.’
Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘He is / one of the best player / in the team.’
questions.e: one of the + બહુવચન: one of the best players.

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘I prefer tea / than / coffee.’
questions.e: prefer સાથે ‘to’: I prefer tea to coffee.

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘The machine / is working / since morning.’
questions.e: since સાથે: has been working since morning.

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘Ten kilometres / are / a long distance to walk.’
questions.e: અંતર/રકમ/સમયને એક એકમ ગણાય: Ten kilometres is a long distance.

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘He did not / came / to the workshop.’
questions.e: did સાથે ક્રિયાપદનું મૂળ રૂપ: did not come.

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘Unless you do not study, / you will / fail.’
questions.e: unless = if not; ફરી ‘not’ ન આવે: Unless you study, you will fail.

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘Though he is poor / but he is / honest.’
questions.e: though સાથે ‘but’ ન આવે; જોઈએ તો ‘yet’ વાપરી શકાય: Though he is poor, he is honest.

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘The sceneries / of Saputara / are beautiful.’
questions.e: scenery અગણ્ય છે: The scenery of Saputara is beautiful.

questions.q: She has been absent ____ Monday.
questions.e: ચોક્કસ સમયબિંદુ (Monday, 2020) → since; સમયગાળો (3 days) → for.

questions.q: He has been working here ____ five years.
The bus stopped ____ the signal.
He is senior ____ me in service.
questions.e: senior, junior, superior, inferior, prior સાથે ‘to’ આવે, ‘than’ નહીં.

questions.q: She is afraid ____ dogs.
The engine is made ____ cast iron.
questions.e: મૂળ પદાર્થ દેખાય → made of. રૂપાંતર થઈ જાય (કાગળ લાકડામાંથી) → made from.

questions.q: Neither the driver nor the conductors ____ present.
questions.e: neither…nor — ક્રિયાપદ નજીકના કર્તા (conductors, બહુવચન) મુજબ: were.

questions.q: The number of buses ____ increased this year.
questions.e: ‘The number of’ → એકવચન (has). ‘A number of’ → બહુવચન (have).

questions.q: A number of students ____ absent today.
If it rains, we ____ the trip.
questions.e: First conditional: If + present, will + base verb.

questions.q: If I had known, I ____ you.
questions.e: Third conditional: If + had + V3, would have + V3.

questions.q: He is ____ heir to the property.
She is ____ one-rupee coin collector.
____ Narmada flows into the Arabian Sea.
I have ____ money left, so I can’t buy it.
questions.e: little = લગભગ નહીંવત (નકારાત્મક ભાવ). a little = થોડું પણ પૂરતું.

questions.q: Let him ____ the work.
He is used to ____ early.
The work ____ before the officer arrived.
questions.e: ભૂતકાળની એક ઘટના પહેલાં બીજી પૂરી — past perfect passive.

questions.q: Choose the correct passive: ‘The mechanic is repairing the bus.’
o: The bus is being repaired by the mechanic.
The bus has been repaired by the mechanic.
The bus was repaired by the mechanic.
The bus is repaired by the mechanic.
questions.e: Present continuous passive: is/are + being + V3.

questions.q: Choose the correct indirect speech: He said, “I am tired.”
o: He told that he was tired.
He said that I am tired.
He said that he is tired.
He said that he was tired.
questions.e: reporting verb ભૂતકાળમાં → am → was, I → he.

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘The teacher / as well as the students / were present.’
questions.e: as well as — ક્રિયાપદ પહેલા કર્તા (teacher) મુજબ: was present.

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘I will call you / after I will reach / the depot.’
questions.e: સમયવાચક ઉપવાક્યમાં ભવિષ્ય માટે simple present: after I reach.

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘He is / too weak / to walk.’
Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘She has / much friends / in the city.’
questions.e: ગણી શકાય તેવા નામ સાથે many: many friends.

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘The pair of shoes / are / new.’
Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘He did not / attend the meeting / because of he was ill.’
questions.e: because of + noun; વાક્ય માટે because: because he was ill.

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘Every driver / should know / the traffic rules.’
Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘My father / gave me / a good news.’
questions.e: news અગણ્ય: good news / a piece of good news.

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘We have / no any / spare tyre.’
questions.e: no અને any સાથે નહીં: no spare tyre / not any spare tyre.

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘The driver drove / very carefully / on the ghat road.’
Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘One should respect / his / elders.’
questions.e: one સાથે one’s: One should respect one’s elders.

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘He is the most / cleverest / boy in the class.’
questions.e: ડબલ superlative ન આવે: the cleverest boy.

questions.q: The bus will not start ____ you switch on the ignition.
He has ____ his work.
She is senior ____ him by two years.
I have been waiting here ____ 9 a.m.
The engine ____ by the mechanic now.
Neither of the two answers ____ correct.
She speaks English ____.
He is the ____ of the two brothers.
This is the depot ____ I work.
The man ____ car was stolen went to the police.
I wish I ____ a bird.
He ____ go to the workshop yesterday.
Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘He has / a lot of / luggages.’
Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘I met / him / yesterday evening.’
Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘She is / elder than / me.’
questions.e: than સાથે older — elder than ખોટું.

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘He was / very much / tired.’
Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘The bus / reached at / the depot late.’
Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘Let him / to go / home.’
Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘I have / lost my / pen yesterday.’
questions.e: yesterday સાથે Simple Past — I lost.

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘The cattle / is grazing / in the field.’
Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘He / avoided / to meet me.’
Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘Each driver / must carry / his licence.’
Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘She / comes here / since 2019.’
Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘My hairs / are / black.’
questions.e: hair (માથાના વાળ) uncountable — My hair is black.

questions.q: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘He is / a M.A. / in English.’
Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘Two and two / make / four.’
Find the part of the sentence that has an error: ‘I am / used to / work late.’
questions.e: be used to + V-ing — working late.

questions.q: He has been ill ____ a week.
The engine ____ overhauled last month.
I would rather walk ____ take a taxi.
He is the man ____ helped me.
The tool ____ you gave me is broken.
She is junior ____ me.
It is time we ____ home.
Hardly ____ the bus started when it broke down.
I have ____ friends in Surat.
There is ____ water in the radiator; fill it.
He ran fast ____ catch the bus.
She prefers coffee ____ tea.
Unless you hurry, you ____ miss the bus.
questions.e: Unless = if not; ‘won’t’ is double negative.

questions.q: He ____ to the cinema last night.
The brakes need ____.
